name: 360 panorama viewer
description: A field formatter that displays images as interactive 360° panoramas.
project_description:
This will provide a field formatter for image fields,so that the images uploaded for an image field that lets users experience a 360° image.

 This module dependency on jquery_ui 

 Installation and Configuration 

 
 Download and enable the module, similar to other Drupal modules. 
 Visit any image field display settings, and you will be able to find the 360° panorama viewer formatter. Select this one, and you can also select image styles. 
 Ex: admin/structure/types/manage/display 
 Have the image field settings "Allowed number of values" to 1 image 
 Add content & images to the node and Save. 
 On node view, a 360° panorama viewer will appear for that image field. 
 Warning: Pictures that are not 360×180 degree panoramas may look strange. 
 
 Integrations 

This module works well with..

Modules like "Views" & other "Core image related modules".

And with other contributed modules related to images,.
